description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers checking and resolving roadmap ## Blockers entries: executing Resolved when conditions, closing settled blockers, deciding the rest in the AI council and asking the owner only for residue. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours: /roadmap:next (selects and ships a roadmap), /roadmap:triage-parked (later/ and skipped/), /roadmap:ai-council (challenges a whole roadmap), /challenge-me closure (closes plan decisions before execution, not blockers), and a read-only dashboard count.
